mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) can cause hypertension and may impair potassium regulation; concurrent potassium supplementation increases hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels carefully; avoid unnecessary potassium supplementation and assess renal function; consider alternative antidepressants if potassium supplementation is essential.
